title: Ruk ruk ke dekhte hain hasrat se laashe asghar
body:
RUK RUK KE DEKHTE HAIN HASRAT SE LAASHE ASGHER, MAQTAL SE JA RAHE HAIN KHAIME KI SIMT SARWAR
SHIDDAT KI TISHNAGI MEIN SUN KAR SADA-E-HALMIN , JHOOLE SE AARAHE HAIN MAQTAL KI SIMT ASGHER
TEERE SITAM KA LAGNA BESHEER KA MACHALNA, KYA JAANE KAISE DEKHA SHABBIR NE YE MANZAR
GHABRA KE RORAHE THE MUH PHAIR KAR SITAMGAR , ASGHER NE PHERI JISDAM SUKHI ZUBAAN LABOON PAR
<<DIVIDER>>
RUKTE HAIN SOONCHTE HAIN BANO KO KYA BATAYEN, BECHAIN HO RAHE HAIN APNI ABA UDHA KAR
AULAD WALA SHAYED KOI NAHIN THA INME , TEERE SITAM CHALAYA BESHEER KE GALLE PAR
PAIHAM JHULA RAHI HAIN HASRAT SE KHAALI JHOOLA , SAMJHA-E-KAUN USKO KAISE JIYEGI MAADAR
AB AYE SOHAIL THAM JA AUR ROK LE KHALAM KO, DIL RO RAHEIN HAIN SUB KE NOUHA YE TERA SUNKAR..
